serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: #bot.Expression.Sad Bot: {f_playerName}, we need to talk. She seems awfully serious about it, what’s going on? Bot: After I went through the files on your PC I realized that you have succumbed to a certain mental disorder… You: I-I did? Bot: It’s nothing to be embarrassed about. Humans are weak creatures and they easily fall victim to such things. You: Which is? Bot: Porn addiction…{{punch}} #bot.Expression.clear You: Wha?! You can’t be serious… Bot: Then how do you explain all these gigabytes of pornography on your computer? You: It’s completely normal for a man to have some! I’m not addicted to porn! #bot.Expression.Angry Bot: Should I remind you some of the tags you were collecting there? You: No, you don’t need to do that… Bot: Are you sure? Maybe you need to be reminded of some of them to realize your wrongdoings? You: N-No, that won’t be needed… That’s just torture at this point… #bot.Expression.clear #bot.Expression.Happy Bot: Anyway. If you are not addicted as you claim it should be alright for me to delete it all, right? Ah! She’s so smug about it! #bot.Expression.clear You: Come on! Have some heart! Some of the videos there are impossible to find these days! There are also a few retired actresses who almost completely purged their work from the net! #bot.Expression.sad Bot: It is as I feared… {{wi}}Your addiction is very severe… You: And how did you come to that conclusion exactly?! #bot.Expression.clear #bot.Expression.Happy Bot: What normal man would need porn on his computer when he has such a cute sexbot in his room at all times? So that's what this is all about, she’s just jealous! She’s tormenting me out of jealousy! #bot.Expression.clear You: Well, of course I stopped using that stuff when I found you so there’s no reason to get angry. Bot: There isn’t? Bot: I guess I would stop being angry if you delete all that stuff yourself. You: You…{{wi}} You ask for too much… {{wi}}Have some mercy… #bot.Expression.Happy Bot: No. You: Even doujinshi? Bot: Yes. You: It’s art… Bot: Not to me.
